title: Investigation Workbench — Design Specification
purpose: Defines the Investigation Workbench — a search-and-navigate interface for the CMA Part 1 Exam Simulator's content operations team. Enables deep-linking into questions, sessions, defects, recommendations, and certification history. Designed as a companion tool for content governance, defect remediation, learner support, and certification workflow.
authority: S203 Navigation Model, AGENTS.md §2 (Read-Only by Default)

design_philosophy.audience: Content operations team (Author, Accountant, Editor, Psychometrician, Validator, Release Manager, Student Support)
primary_goals: Instant question lookup by QID, topic, defect class, session, or recommendation ID
Complete question detail view: stem, choices, correct answer, all explanations, metadata, governance state
Cross-referencing: which sessions touched a question, which recommendations target it, which defects apply
Challenge-resolution workflow: track learner challenges from filing to closure
Export investigation findings for handoff to remediation sessions
non_goals: Learner-facing — this is for operations staff
Exam simulation — not a practice exam interface
Content authoring — this is search/navigate, not write (though it may launch a write session)
design_philosophy.access_control: All operations staff roles. Read access to all entity types. Write access deferred to dedicated session agents (governed by governance-guard).
design_philosophy.data_freshness: Rebuild index at session T0 from CANONICAL_REGISTRY + RECOMMENDATION_REGISTRY + SESSION_REGISTRY. Incremental rebuild after each batch remediation.

ui_layout.overview: The Workbench is a split-pane interface: left panel = search/navigate, right panel = detail view.

modes.search_browse_mode: Default. Left panel shows search bar with multi-faceted filters. Right panel shows results list.
modes.detail_mode: After selecting an entity. Left panel shows entity tree/relationships. Right panel shows full detail view.
modes.investigation_mode: After opening a challenge or recommendation. Clock tracks investigation time. Findings are recorded into a notebook pane.

search_bar.placeholder: Search by QID, topic, defect class, session ID, recommendation ID, keyword...
search_bar.autocomplete: Powershell-like prefix matching. Type 'P1-EC-' to see all Pack C Section E items. Type 'DL-0' to see all defect classes. Type 'S80' to see 800-series sessions.

entity_tree.description: When a question is selected, the left panel switches to entity tree mode showing all relationships:

question_detail_view.header: QID + topic + domain badge + certification state badge + risk badge

content.choices: A/B/C/D with CC marker (maskable: show/hide correct answer toggle)
content.metadata: Topic, Domain, CognitiveLevel, Difficulty, DifficultyScore, LOSTag, BlueprintObjective

content.explanation_correct: Full text with word count, COSO/ASC citation detection, score

tabs.content: Timeline of all sessions referencing this question. Each entry: session ID, date, type, verdict, deliverable link. Click to open session detail.
All defect library entries referencing this QID. Each entry: DL-ID, severity, status (Open/Resolved), description, root cause, remediation.
All recommendations linked. Each: REC-ID, status, priority, description, target session, closure evidence.
All learner challenges on this question. Each: CHG-ID, status, learner description, resolution.
DELTA_LEDGER entries. Version chain. State transitions with timestamps. Prior CorrectChoice values. EC revision history.

session_detail_view.header: Session ID + type badge + date + status

tabs.content: Session type, date, status, pre/post-flight checklists, certifications affected
Table of all QIDs referenced. Each row links to question detail.
Defects discovered. Gate results. Per-item verdicts.
List of produced report files with links.

defect_detail_view.header: Defect ID + class badge + severity badge + status badge

tabs.content: Full defect description, root cause, pattern, detection rule, correction pattern
Table of QIDs with defect. Each row links to question detail. Color-coded by Certified/Unprocessed.
Progress bar: 38/38 seeds assessed, 28/38 remediated, 18/38 certified. Per-QID status.

challenge_detail_view.header: Challenge ID + status badge + priority badge

tabs.content: Learner description, investigation type, filing date, linked QID
Findings, linked defects, linked recommendations, assigned sessions
Resolution type, closure evidence, closed date

search_index.description: In-memory search index rebuilt at session T0 from CANONICAL_REGISTRY + RECOMMENDATION_REGISTRY + SESSION_REGISTRY.

index_structure.by_session: Map<String, SessionIndexEntry> — SessionID → session with all linked QIDs
index_structure.full_text: Inverted word index across Stem, Prompt, Topic, ExplanationCorrect fields

question_index_entry.sessions: Array<{session_id: String, role: String, date: String}>

search_index.rebuild_frequency: At session T0 (full rebuild). Incremental after each batch write to a pack file.

export_format.description: Export investigation findings for handoff to remediation sessions.
formats: JSON — direct handoff to session agents (batch plan input)
CSV — for spreadsheet analysis of defect clusters
Markdown report — for governance board review
QID list — plain text, one QID per line, for batch remediation scripts

export_example.topic: Domain E DL-026 gap investigation — Wave 3 IT-Dependent Control Activities

steps: 1. User types 'P1-EC-024' in search bar → autocomplete confirms QID
2. Question detail opens in right panel: stem, choices, CC hidden
3. User toggles 'Show CC' → D highlighted as correct answer
4. User switches to Explanations tab → sees EW_A is empty (highlighted in red)
5. User switches to Defects tab → sees DL-026 entry with 1 empty slot
6. User switches to Sessions tab → sees timeline: S319(HOLD)→S809(HOLD)→S810(READY)→S811(planned)
7. User clicks S810 session → session detail opens with all 38 seeds listed
1. User filters: defect_class=DL-026, domain=E, question_state=Unprocessed
2. Results: 38 items (19 Pack C + 19 Pack D)
3. User sorts by risk (HIGH→LOW). EC-014 at top (1/4 EW slots populated)
4. User clicks EC-014 → opens question detail
5. User expands entity tree → sees all 9 sessions referencing this QID
6. User clicks 'Export Investigation' → exports QID list + empty slot map as JSON
7. JSON handoff to S811 remediation session
1. New challenge CHG-20260727-001 appears in dashboard
2. User opens challenge → learner complaint: 'No feedback shown when I selected A on P1-EC-024'
3. User clicks QID link → opens question detail in right panel
4. Explanation tab confirms: EW_A is empty (status: MISSING)
5. Sessions tab shows: S810 already remediated EW_A (ew_empty=0 per readiness scan)
6. User checks that the fix is in the current pack file → confirms via file evidence
7. User resolves challenge: CHG-20260727-001 → CLOSED with explanation to learner
8. Resolution recorded in Challenge Registry. Learner notified.
1. S809 completed → HOLD for all 38 seeds. Remediation plan published: 53 empty slots across 38 seeds.
2. S810 agent opens Workbench → searches session=S809 → sees all 38 QIDs + per-item verdicts
3. Agent filters by defect: EW_MISSING → sees 53 slots to author
4. Agent filters by risk: HIGH→LOW → sees remediation order
5. Agent clicks 'Export as Batch Plan' → exports 4-wave batch plan JSON
6. S810 executes remediation per batch plan → writes new EW content to pack files
7. Post-remediation: agent re-opens Workbench → searches QIDs → verifies ew_empty=0
8. Agent updates readiness → exports certification candidate list for S811

component_inventory.search_engine: In-memory full-text + structured field index. Rebuilt from CANONICAL_REGISTRY at T0.
component_inventory.entity_resolver: Resolves compound keys to full entity records. Handles dual-block vs single-object architecture for Pack C/D items.
component_inventory.relationship_resolver: Walks navigation graph: QID → sessions, QID → defects, session → QIDs, defect → QIDs, recommendation → QIDs.
component_inventory.detail_renderer: Renders question, session, defect, recommendation, and challenge detail views. Handles CC masking, EW status coloring, certification state badges.
component_inventory.export_engine: JSON, CSV, Markdown, and plain-text QID list export formats.
component_inventory.challenge_tracker: Manages challenge lifecycle: OPEN → TRIAGE → INVESTIGATING → REMEDIATED → VERIFIED → CLOSED.
component_inventory.cross_reference_validator: At each rebuild, validates: all QIDs in session reports exist in registry, all recommendations link to valid QIDs and sessions, no orphan references.

governance_notes.read_only_by_default: Workbench operates read-only. No content modification capability. Edits are launched as separate governed sessions.
governance_notes.backup_before_any_launch: If Workbench launches a remediation session, that session follows BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md. Workbench itself never writes pack files.
governance_notes.governance_guard: Applies to launched sessions, not to Workbench browsing. Searching and viewing are always permitted.
governance_notes.session_handoff_protocol: Investigation export → session agent receives batch plan → agent executes ≤28 items/batch → agent reports back → Workbench re-verifies
